newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end flat, outlook seen bullish.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end flat, outlook seen bullish.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended flat on Tuesday after an initial slump in prices encouraged buying, with some final investors re-emerging, dealers said.
In the short term, the outlook is still seen bullish, on the continual entry of funds into stocks from bonds. The Ibex is seen headed up to 7,000.
The general index fell 0.31 points, 0.05 percent to 592.08 while the Ibex-35 shed 4.87 points, 0.07 percent, to 6,797.08, but set a fresh intraday high at 6,831.69.
Repsol sheds 1.42 percent to 6,270 pesetas as traders took profits. Resistance was pegged at 6,250 pesetas.
Final clients were particularly interested in banks, dealers said. Santander added 50 pesetas to 4,650, BBV rose 30 pesetas to 11,710 and Popular gained 150 pesetas to 33,100.

Also in focus were stocks due to be incorporated into the blue chip index as of July 1. Steel tubing firm Tubacex gained 26 pesetas to 466, Asturiana del Zinc fell 15 pesetas to 2,825 and Viscofan rose 185 pesetas to 3,435.
"With the expiry of the special (cleansed black market) debt next week, we'll get fresh funds coming into the market, so the outlook is good," the dealer added.
